count_discrepancy.note: The notice states 575 Tribal entities, while its published name list contains 577 distinct records. All published name records are preserved. The difference is not resolved here.

scope_note: This is the federal list published on 30 January 2026. It is not a list of all Indigenous peoples or all governing bodies in the United States. Federal recognition is not a definition of Indigenous identity.
